scope: V2V wall initiate/join protocol + wider coop awareness + protocol bank ingestion; CPU implementation and CPU contract tests only (no SUMO/GPU/ssh)

commits.subject: C4 W1: V2V wall initiate/join protocol, wider coop awareness, protocol bank ingestion (default off)

context: REGISTRATION.md r9/r12 Nov 6 observability limit (4 of 5 mined wall examples: no member sees all members in its 4 slots)

v2v_wall.range_m: optional float > 0 (message radio range), default 100.0 = V2V_RANGE_M

config_keys.default: both keys absent (or False) = OFF; validated for B/R in track2_backend._check; A never reads them

how_to_enable: Add the same keys to the common B/R backend config (registration), e.g. v2v_wall={enabled:true, member_cap:4, rule:'w1-v2v-wall-initiate-join-v1', provenance:'<owner>'[, range_m:200.0]} and/or coop_awareness={enabled:true, slots:6, range_m:200.0, rule:'w1-coop-awareness-v1', provenance:'<owner>'}.
Either option can be enabled alone; both are identical for B and R; A (plain MAPPO) is untouched.

Start from MAPPO u0 with fresh B/R track2 sidecars: the trigger first layer (and, with awareness, the residual first layer) gains zero-initialised columns, so OFF-run sidecars do not strict-load into an ON config.
No launch/registration file was changed; the operator owns budget, registration and smoke before any physics.

api.protocol: v2v_wall.Protocol (EpisodePolicy.wall): receive(now, own_rows) -> offers from messages published at now-1 within range_m; publish(now, own sources) after each sample(); start(option, ego, executor, ...) = atomic session cap/ownership + MoveExecutor commitment; offsets(option, t, positions, vid)
api.options: WallOption(family in ('wall_initiate','wall_join'), members=(ego,), onset/hold relative, depth, wall_id, initiator, gap_m, member_count, cap, range_m); a join is the remaining part of the initiator absolute schedule
api.message: WallIntent(wall_id, initiator, timestamp_s, source_s_m, source_lane, start_s, onset, hold, depth, zone=registered merge zone, member_count (joins acknowledged by t-1), cap, released)
api.decisions: initiate offered at periodic decisions to a free CAV upstream of the merge zone (variety windows clipped to its constant-speed zone arrival, as the wall move); first receipt of a wall -> one-shot non-periodic event decision (join-only slate for receivers, none for others); join also offered at periodic decisions while received
api.trigger_inputs: TriggerPolicy(extension=...): descriptor += (is_initiate, is_join, initiator_gap/range, member_count/cap, open_slots/6); context += own merge-pressure block (wall) + awareness block; all extra first-layer columns zero-initialised; frozen MAPPO trunk input unchanged
api.awareness: per slot (gap_m, lane_offset, v_mps, present) for the K nearest other CAV publishers whose own t-1 packet is valid within range_m, + merge_features over those packets (merge_features k/range_m kwargs, defaults unchanged); inserted before the committed-offset column of the residual; candidate slates/visible slots unchanged
api.ingestion: bank_breadth.observable_contexts routes every verified wall-family example (mined and legacy, B and R alike) to v2v_wall.protocol_contexts when v2v_wall is on: initiator (member reaching most other members within range_m, ties plan order) imitates wall_initiate from its own observation; each other member imitates wall_join at the earliest second its own receive step produced the offer for the reconstructed t-1 message; admitted in stable order up to member_cap
api.g4: sparse_synergy_credit.opportunities skips per-CAV protocol options (not single-proposer joint macros)
api.r_arm: no arm-specific code: R runs the identical protocol online and ingests its own (random-proposer) verified wall examples through the same rule

covers: settings default off / registered values / cap<=6 / slots in {4,6} / range>=100
off = byte-identical: absent vs False identical; subprocess overlay of 3e5bc9f9 sources gives an identical sample+weight digest
message timing t-1 (not same tick; a skipped publication is not received)
join option only within range; HDVs never offered or commanded
single-writer execution: initiator and joiner share the absolute window via committed offsets
ownership (owned CAV gets none only; a member cannot initiate/join again) and member cap
release message latch / zone release / ownership held to expiry
MAPPO observation and frozen base untouched
awareness zero-init equivalence (K=6/250 m, K=4/200 m, K=6/100 m): identical actions, trigger tables/logp, residuals
B and R identical protocol runs and identical bank supervision
4-member wall where no member sees all others: legacy path 0 contexts; protocol initiate+joins (range 100: 1+2, range 200: 1+3, cap 3: 1+2)
ingestion uses only own observation + received message; recorded wall decisions replay for trigger PPO; G4 ignores them

tests.lint: ruff: v2v_wall.py clean; touched modules no new findings; test file only the repo-standard F811 cfg-fixture import
tests.not_run: SUMO, GPU, Linux qualification, clean3 smoke/admit_mined on the real bank

caveats: Zero-init equivalence is guaranteed for coop_awareness. Enabling v2v_wall adds new slate options, so an untrained ON policy can select them (logits of pre-existing candidates are unchanged).

With v2v_wall on, wall-family bank examples are taught via initiate/join instead of the direct joint wall label (B and R alike); the F3 B/R family-support check then needs wall examples in both arms, as before.
Protocol latency: joiners start one second after the initiation and run the remaining schedule; the first second of an onset-0 plan is not reproduced for joiners.
With the default 100 m message range, 986061-like geometry (60 m spacing) reaches 2 of 3 partners; a longer registered range_m (e.g. 200 m) reaches all; this is an owner registration choice.
coop_awareness K=6 widens coop-layer inputs only; it does not change trigger_partner_slots or move membership.
hard_rules: no ssh/SUMO/GPU; worktree only; no reset/clean/stash drop/push/rebase; no sealed/holdout/cal_split/chunk5/j4b/inc1 paths or truth files read; policy inputs are observables only
